title: Persona selector changes the quick-action set and the role sent on subsequent chat requests
steps: On /assistant, change the role Select from 'Compliance' to 'CISO'
Observe the Quick Actions list change (e.g. 'Threat Landscape', 'Risk Metrics' appear)
Send a message and inspect the request body's role field
expectedResult: Quick Actions immediately reflect the CISO-specific set (roleActions.ciso), and the outgoing chat request carries role:'ciso' instead of the previous persona — the UI-selected persona overrides the JWT-derived default (extractPrimaryRole fallback).

title: Markdown response renders headings, lists, tables, and links safely via marked + DOMPurify
description: BlockRenderer's MarkdownBlock parses with marked (breaks:true, gfm:true) and sanitizes with DOMPurify before dangerouslySetInnerHTML — no hand-rolled markdown parsing exists on this path.
steps: Ask a question likely to produce a markdown-formatted answer with a heading, a bullet list, and a link
expectedResult: Headings render bold/larger, bullet lists render with indentation, links render underlined and are clickable — no raw markdown syntax (##, -, [text](url)) is visible as literal text, and no injected <script>/onerror attributes execute if present in the source text.

title: Table block shows a 'Showing X of Y rows' caption only when rows are truncated
steps: Trigger a response whose table block has total_rows greater than the returned rows.length (e.g. a large evidence list capped to 20 rows)
Trigger a second response whose table has total_rows equal to rows.length
expectedResult: The first case shows 'Showing 20 of N rows' below the table. The second case shows no such caption — it only appears when total_rows exceeds the displayed row count.

title: Donut chart block only renders when there are at least 2 segments
description: DonutBlock returns null when segments map to fewer than 2 data points — a single-segment pie chart is not a meaningful visualization and should silently not render rather than show a broken/degenerate chart.
steps: Trigger (or mock) a response whose donut block has only 1 segment
Trigger a response whose donut block has 2+ segments
expectedResult: The 1-segment case renders nothing for that block (no empty chart frame). The 2+-segment case renders the pie/donut with a legend and tooltip.

title: Voice input appends transcribed text to the composer without overwriting what was already typed
steps: Type a partial question into the composer
Click the microphone/voice input button and dictate additional text
expectedResult: The transcribed text is appended after the existing input (separated by a space), not replacing it; the composer remains editable afterward.

title: A Python backend timeout surfaces as a retryable, human-readable error rather than a raw stack trace
description: PythonBackendClient's AbortController fires PythonBackendTimeoutError (504, isRetryable:true) on a fetch abort; chat.routes.ts maps this to the response's error/message/retryable fields, which the client toasts as 'Service error'.
preconditions: Ability to simulate a slow/unresponsive Python AI backend (> configured timeout)
steps: Trigger a chat request against a mocked/delayed backend exceeding AI_ASSISTANT_TIMEOUT
expectedResult: A toast reading something like 'AI Assistant is temporarily unavailable' or the specific timeout message appears; the message is marked retryable, and no raw exception/stack trace is shown to the end user.
